description.en: Immediately sets the controlled camera's position and reference (look-at) point, and syncs the camera-control state to match (no interpolation).
Handle of the camera being controlled.
6-element array [posX, posY, posZ, refX, refY, refZ] with the new camera position and reference point.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Snapping the camera to a fixed position and reference point
